test.//: Public meta-test barrel. Composes private _test:* subtargets via dependsOn — has no executor body of its own. Each subtarget enforces one structural workspace invariant. See docs/scratch/data-extension-contract.md §6 'Workspace Target Architecture' for the full pattern; tests/README.md describes individual invariants. Adding a new invariant: drop a script under scripts/_test/, add a `_test:<name>` private target below, append to `dependsOn` here.

_test:project-mirror.//: Every src/{domain}/{Project} has a corresponding tests/{domain}/{Project}.Tests at the mirrored path. Private subtarget: invoked only by the tests:test barrel.

_test:conformance-presence.//: Every first-party Flowthru extension implementing a Core surface has at least one matching *Conformance subclass in its sibling test project. Private subtarget: invoked only by the tests:test barrel.

_test:dead-schemas.//: Every type declared under tests/helpers/Flowthru.Tests.Kits/Schemas/ is referenced as a type argument by at least one *Conformance<...> subclass. Catches schemas authored without follow-through. Private subtarget.

_test:dead-fixtures.//: Every fixture file under tests/helpers/Flowthru.Tests.Kits/Fixtures/ is referenced (by literal path) from at least one conformance subclass. Catches fixtures authored without wired-up consumers. Private subtarget.

_test:diagnostic-id-registration.//: Every FT### / FU### diagnostic ID emitted from src/ is registered in some AnalyzerReleases.{Un,}shipped.md. Workspace-level backstop for Roslyn's release-tracking analyzer. Private subtarget.

_test:planner-consumption.//: Every IFormatSerializer<TRow> implementor under src/extensions/ either references PropertyMappingPlanner / PropertyMappingPlan<> or carries [OptOutOfPropertyPlanner]. Backstops the Phase B contract that format extensions consume Core's universal property-walk cascade rather than reimplementing it. Private subtarget.

_test:capability-matrix-freshness.//: Regenerates docs/reference/extensions/capability-matrix.md via the file-based C# program at scripts/_test/capability-matrix.cs and asserts the regenerated content matches the committed file. Drift means a format's RowFeatures, [OptOutOfPropertyPlanner] reason, or implemented capability segment changed without a paired matrix update. Private subtarget. The same generator script is invoked by docs:_build-capability-matrix; freshness is a workspace-discipline concern (here), generation is a docs-build concern (in docs:project.json).

_test:row-features-claims.//: Every Supports* = true claim on a RowFeatures property has a corresponding *Conformance<...> subclass that overrides RequiredFeatures referencing that flag. Catches 'extension lies about its capabilities.' Private subtarget.

_test:row-features-inventory.//: Every flag on FormatRowFeatures is referenced in the row-shape feature surface table (currently in docs/scratch/data-extension-contract.md §2; migrates to src/extensions/CONTRIBUTING.md after Phase E). Catches drift between the type and its documentation. Private subtarget.

test:integration.//: Run only integration-tagged tests (e.g. Postgres-backed EFCore conformance via TestContainers). Requires Docker. Skipped by default in nx run affected -t test; intended for nightly CI runs and on-demand local validation.

coverage:purge.//: Remove all TestResults directories to force a clean test run

commands: find tests -name TestResults -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true

coverage:sync.//: Sync codecov.yml flags and components from the current project graph and stage the file for commit. Must run before the release commit so the updated codecov.yml is included.

coverage:upload.//: Upload all coverage.cobertura.xml files found under tests/ to Codecov. Depends on coverage:sync so dist/codecov-flags.json exists regardless of prior workflow steps — CI used to fail with 'flags.json not found' when the test step bailed before the explicit Sync step ran. Requires CODECOV_TOKEN env var and the codecov CLI on PATH.
